title: Grateful Dead Live at International Speedway on 1969-12-28
lineage: Panasonic SV-3700 > Cardas cable S/PDIF > Edirol UA-5 > USB > WaveLab > CD Wave > TLH > Flac

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a solid show – great audio quality but a performance that falls short of the band's very best.
ai_review.review: The reviewer praises the recording’s crystal‑clear sound, rating the audio itself five stars, while noting the musical performance is only “pretty good” and assigning it four stars. No specific songs or mishaps are mentioned, suggesting an overall enjoyable but not landmark concert.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviewer rates sound quality at five stars and the show at four; weighted combination (70% performance, 30% audio) yields ~4.3 overall.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Great, clear sound with no reported issues; reviewer specifically calls the sound quality 'great' and gives it five stars.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Performance considered solid but not among the Dead's top shows; enjoyable overall but lacking standout moments.
